# Odense Universitetshospital

Odense Universitetshospital is a Danish hospital named once in the ADHD_2024 report, specifically in connection with its Svendborg site: "Odense Universitetshospital - Svendborg" [^src1]. According to the entity's stated significance, this is the hospital where Jens Tofte works as chief physician (ledende overlæge) [^src1].

The mention appears within a section of the report covering the steering group members for the ADHD database and appendices detailing the database population for the period 1 April 2024 – 31 March 2025. That steering group draws representatives from all five Danish regions, professional societies, patient organizations, and the Danish Clinical Quality Program (Sundhedsvæsenets Kvalitetsinstitut), and the appendices document the number and demographic distribution of ADHD assessment and treatment pathways among children, young people, and adults, along with regional variation in the use of the pathway marker for refuted suspicions [^src1]. Beyond this single mention, no further relationships, claims, or timeline events involving Odense Universitetshospital are documented in the corpus.
